notes.title: Update 1.8.0
notes.notes:
Welcome to Update 1.8.0!

This week's store update includes a hint of nostalgia with it!

Check out the trailer below for a quick overview on the update:

[previewyoutube=Op0SGHRmKX8;full][/previewyoutube]

We currently investigating cloning issues with the user interface, and how it can lead to the game becoming unstable after multiple matches. We plan to fix these issues in the coming updates, but it'll take some time as we have to dive deep into the game's core to solve these problems. In the meantime, simply restarting the game should fix this issue.

Lastly, remember to enter code 4THOFJULY into your account tab, as the code will be expiring on July 17!

Here's the full list of changes:

BALANCE
RPG

Reduced damage in Legendary rarity from 150 -> 125

Reduced reload time for 3 -> 2 seconds
Dev note: The RPG is supposed to be a heavy hitting weapon with a tradeoff of it's reloading time. However we noticed that reloading took too long and in higher rarities the weapon became too strong. So we've reduced the reload time and damage to make the weapon strong, but more fair.

G-15

Decreased fire rate from 10 -> 7.5

Reduced damage in Legendary rarity from 23 -> 20

Reduced damage in Epic rarity from 20 -> 17

COSMETICS

Significantly improved the Fireflight backbling model

FIXES

Fixed an issue where the GUI of eliminations would bug out when entering double digits

Fixed an issue where the Fireflight backbling description would not show

notes.title: Update 1.7.0
notes.notes:
Welcome to Update 1.7.0!

Our Summer Splashdown event may have ended, but that doesn't mean our summer festivities are over just yet!

Check out the trailer below for a quick overview on the update:

[previewyoutube=VfmpZuuu70k;full][/previewyoutube]

Last update, we temporarily disabled the localization feature from the game, as a result of a bug that caused issues when it came to properly translating languages. Unfortunately, we were unable to fix it in time for this update as we are currently rewriting the entire localization system, making it more optimal, improved and getting it ready for future language introductions. We hope to have working by next update, if not then the next one after that.

This week, we're treating you to (yet) another summer event: Firework Bonanaza! In this event, you can explore brand new map changes, nab a fresh batch of cosmetics and, most importantly, fire some sweet explosive fireworks with our new permanent arsenal addition, the RPG!

And last, but certainly not least, enter code 4THOFJULY in your account tab for a free gift!

Here's the full list of changes:

STORE

New store bundle: Big League Set; features a new outfit, backbling and glider

Free limited-time store bundle: Summer Cookout Set: includes a outfit and backbling

Extended the store date for the Summer Days Set; it will now leave on July 11


WEAPONS
RPG

A explosive rocket launcher, can only be fired once before requiring a lengthy reload

Super Soaker

Removed from loot pool


USER INTERFACE

Improved the GUI of eliminations along with victory and defeat screens

Renamed Season Shop to "Season Pass"

Added a new shop section: Bundles
Dev note: To make the shop less cluttered, we made a new section that is dedicated to bundles only, instead of making them take up space reserved for special offers. All bundles will be located here from now on, but if a bundle is marked as "limited-time" then they will be there until the date labeled on them passes.


FIXES

Fixed Fightbot3000's additional style not correctly showing up in matches

Fixed an issue where the Emotijon backbling couldn't be earned when at the correct level

Fixed incorrect pricing on store items

Fixed the Lobby background animation effects appearing on incorrect UI screens

Fixed an issue where outfits that players didn't own would show in the Lobby

Fixed an issue with the Lobby effects suddenly disappearing on the correct UI screen
Dev note: We solved this issue by significantly increasing the amount of effects and clones that the game is limited to, however we are aware that this may cause some issues regarding the game's stability so we will be closely monitoring this fix into next week's update.

notes.title: Season 1 | Update 1.5.0
notes.notes:
Welcome to Season 1!

The game has changed! Welcome to the Island, combatants!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42960228/3d21ae7049433139bb3fad3533f0fc955abbc116.png

SEASON PASS

Eight unique rewards, all of them free! Earn XP and level up in the pass to unlock brand new cosmetics--available only for this season! The higher the level requirement in the Season Pass, the better the reward! Progress throughout the season to unlock those sweet rewards before the season ends, in which case those rewards will never be brought back!

LEADERBOARDS

Fight your way to the number one spot! Earn XP by playing matches, where the better you place in a match, the more XP you earn towards your leaderboard placement. Only five players can be on the leaderboard at anytime, so you'll have to fight tooth and nail if you want to reach the podium!

ACCOUNT LEVELING

Earn rewards for progressing in the game! By playing matches, eliminating opponents, winning or placing high, you'll earn XP which goes to your account level. Everytime you rank up in your account level, you'll earn our brand new currency, Gemini, which we've swapped for Gold. You can use Gemini to purchase cosmetics in the store, which are at no additional cost!

PROFILE

Curious to see how you're performing in your matches? Look no further, as the profile system is here! The Profile tab keeps tracks of all your wins, matches played and eliminations! Compare them with others to see whose better, or just keep them hidden...if you're that embarrassed that is.

SAVING SYSTEM

You asked, and we answered. That's right, you'll finally be able to start saving your account progress throughout each update! When you head over to the profile tab, you'll see two buttons: Save Data and Load Data, and each button does you what think it does. After saving your account, copy the number code it gives you and then paste it when you go to load your account data, and be sure to keep it somewhere safe and memorable to avoid losing your progress!

STORE OVERHAUL

It's about time we took a revisit at our store, don't you agree? This update, we've completely reworked the store into something both bigger and better! Going forward, the store is divided into three separate tabs, each with their own function listed below!
DAILY ITEMS: This tab will constantly rotate items in and out of the store, so check back everyday to see what's new!

SPECIAL OFFERS: This tab contains special items, such as bundles, holiday cosmetics, etc. This tab may not update has often as the Daily Items, but when it does, prepare for some goodies!

SEASON SHOP: This tab is the home of the Season Pass, here is where you can unlock your cosmetics! Each cosmetic is locked behind a certain level, but regardless you'll be able to preview the outfit before you unlock it. And when you do reach the level requirement, it will not cost anything!
WEAPONS

We've completely overhauled our old weapons in favor of a more unique weapon arsenal. Land on the Island, grab your new loot and get to fighting!
GALIL: Automatic rifle, 35 bullets per magazine. Medium fire rate out of the rifles.

M4A1: Automatic rifle, 30 bullets per magazine. Fastest fire rate out of the rifles.

AK49: Automatic rifle, 35 bullets per magazine. Slowest fire rate out of the rifles.

KSG: Semi-automatic shotgun. 8 bullets per magazine. Medium fire rate.

KS-23: Pump-action shotgun, 6 bullets per magazine. Slow fire rate.

G-15: Automatic pistol, 15 bullets per magazine. Extremely fast fire rate.

M1911: Semi-automatic pistol, 8 bullets per magazine. Medium fire rate.

USER INTERFACE

We've greatly improved the user interface, making it a cleaner experience along with making it fit with the current aesthetic of the season. We're constantly striving for a comfortable experience when it comes to navigating the interface and would love feedback regarding this change!

NEW GAMEMODE

This update, we're introducing the Experimental gamemode as a permanent addition to the game. This mode will allow you to land on your own private island and be able to test out all the weapons without fearing of being eliminated! As the season continues, we'll be introducing more gamemodes, so stay tuned!

LOCKER UPDATE

The Locker is getting some sweet changes! First, we've improved the UI for customizing and made it look much nicer. Second, we're introducing additional styles for cosmetics! Going forward, if a skin you purchase has a "wheel" icon on it, you can select from multiple different styles of that cosmetic!

We're also introducing two more cosmetic types aswell, backblings and gliders! Customize your glider to change what you land in with, or customize your backbling to see what fits you outfit!

MAP UPDATES

We've improved the graphical side of the map, cleaning up the artstyle and optimizing it to avoid long load times and reducing the frequency of crashes. We have bigger map updates coming over the next few updates, especially with one right around the corner, stay tuned!

SFX

As you may notice when you launch the game, we've improved the sounds both in the user interface aswell as soundtrack wise. That's right, we've got a new custom soundtrack that you can listen to right now in-game! (We hope you enjoy it, it took a lot of time to get it right!) 


As we come to a close on this post, we want to thank everyone for their patience regarding this update. There's been alot of work put into this one update, and we hope you enjoy all the new changes and additions to the game. There are more updates on the way in the coming weeks, so stay up-to-date with our socials to see what's coming next for the game! 

Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today's update is introducing a complete new revamp of the game's User Interface and much more!
We've reworked the interface to provide a much cleaner and smoother look for the game that'll be used going forward, we hope you like it! Additionally, we've introduced a new localization option: Spanish. In the future, we'll be introducing the implementation of two more languages, which should hopefully come in the later months.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42960228/86e342561710c32659ac1ed955a9de7977f900d8.png

Following this update, we're going to be taking a little revisit on our update schedule. If we're being completely honest, the schedule we decided to go with just isn't viable long term. For the updates to come out that frequently and often with high-quality, it would require an entire rewrite for the content that is planned to come out this year. 

That being said, the update schedule we set isn't most likely going to be followed for the rest of this year. We know this is disappointing considering the fact that we haven't even really been able to start following it when it comes to content. Updates will obviously resume for the rest of this year, but it won't be as often as we had planned it to be. Stuff is still coming, don't worry, and we hope it makes up for this announcement.

Lastly, we've got another update coming next week! This update will celebrate the Lunar New Year, and will feature some brand new cosmetics and some neat map changes! We've got quite a bit coming in next week's update, so be on the lookout for that. Now without further ado, let's get on with the patch notes.

General:

Complete overhaul of the game's user interface, providing a much smoother and cleaner look for the game.

New Language added - Spanish! We're working on adding more languages in the future with full localization support.

Internal optimization - We've cleaned the game's internal structure, getting rid of unneeded assets, code optimization, and just overhauling old internal systems and improving them. This should improve the game's download size, future patch sizes, and the game's performance.

Shop:

Adjusted shop prices

Uncommon: 500 Gold

Rare: 800 Gold

Epic: 1500 Gold

Legendary: 2000 Gold


Improved the UI for shop cosmetics, both in the Shop page and in the Item Preview

Updated description texts for cosmetics, simplifying them or adjusting them

Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where the Lobby background randomly became broken

Fixed an issue where some Setting options would appear on the Lobby screen

Fixed an issue where some cosmetics in the shop displayed the wrong text

Fixed an issue where some cosmetics wouldn't properly display in matches

notes.title: Fortune: Rewritten - Christmas 2023 Update!
notes.notes:
Ho, ho, ho!
Happy holidays everybody, and Merry Christmas!

The chilly winds of winter have finally arrived to the island, featuring balancing updates, new weapons, new cosmetics and more! We have a LOT to discuss and explain in today's major update, so without further ado, let's dive right into it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42960228/aad77d9584fabee7011f3a18bf6e528d86f6d1ed.png
New Cosmetics!

We've made sure to pack the shop with brand new cosmetics that are available for purchase! Grab a "Ugly Sweater" costume if you're feeling cozy, or snatch of the "Snowed In" costumes for the official Christmas set. Additionally, make sure to grab some extra costumes as part of a "Thank you!" gift in the store, which will be on sale for a limited time.

Keep in mind, cosmetics that are listed as a "Holiday Set" will not come back to the item shop until the next time the holiday rolls around. For example, take the previously released Halloween skins, those skins will not be returning to the store until Halloween next year. This should hopefully make more sense when you see a cosmetic that is label as "Limited Time".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42960228/542730da2456039544bce6c7e63265644237378c.png

Limited Time Event - Frostivus!

As part of our winter update, we're also introducing a limited time winter event, called Frostivus. From December 22 to January 8, 2023, the Frostivus event will be live and will feature a limited time weapons, cosmetics and item shop sales. 

So if you're in the winter spirt, make sure to grab one of the cosmetics for this year's Christmas update, as they won't be back until next year!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42960228/dbcd202794945156d6b186716b0253c19ec646fe.png
Balancing Changes

This update brings alot of changes to our arsenal. Firstly, we wanted to properly adjust the overall damage rate of weapon rarities. Common weapons will now do significantly less damage than before, and so will Uncommon weapons, however not as much. Rare weapons will receive a slight nerf, but should overall still be a viable option. These changes were made to provide the AI with a better chances of eliminating the player, and adjusting weapon damage output should hopefully make the AI more of a threat.  

Additionally, weapon recoil effects have been slightly adjusted. Weapons now feature realistic recoil rates, which means that depending on the weapon (for example, think of the submachine gun.) it will feature more or less intense kickback when firing. For example, the double barrel shotgun will still have a decent amount recoil when firing, but not as much as before, even when compared to the submachine gun. It should be noted that not all weapons will be affected by this balancing update, only a few. But the rest of the weapons will be monitored in case they need adjusting.

Tactical Shotgun

A standard, sharp, and powerful shotgun. A nice option to go with when it comes to fighting your opponent. This is quite a common weapon you'll find on the island, which does do quite a bit of damage. These changes should hopefully make it less strong, whilst making it a still viable option. Note that all of these changes affects all of the shotguns that are listed as "Tactical", except the Double Barrel, as they're categorized as the same type of the weapon.

Damage Output Changes:

Legendary: 87 -> 80
Epic: 83 -> 77
Rare: 75 -> 73
Uncommon: 75 -> 60
Common: 71 -> 53

Double Barrel Shotgun

The Double Barrel Shotgun is a powerful weapon, understandably so. But the high damage output that the weapon had lead to matches ending quicker than expected. So we're nerfing it's damage output to better slowdown the pace of the match just a bit. However, the damage output change might be a little overboard, so we'll be closely monitoring it's performance after this change. Additionally, we've also slightly increased the weapon's recoil rate after each fire shot, making it a bit more harder to land your shots due to it's power.

Damage Output Changes:

Legendary: 95 -> 79
Epic: 70 -> 63

Recoil Output Changes:

Recoil: 6 -> 9

Submachine Gun

Although it is a weapon that you might not encounter very often during a match, the submachine was still a viable option because of it's quick fire rate. However, due to it's lackluster damage output, it's pick rates were low, and thus the weapon will be receiving a buff due to it's damage output. Additionally, we'll be slightly tuning the recoil rate, as a bit of compensation for this change.

Damage Output Changes:

Legendary: 19  -> 43
Epic: 17 -> 37
Rare: 16 -> 29
Uncommon: 15 -> 25
Common: 22 -> 24

Recoil Output Changes:

Recoil: 2.5 -> 3.5

Tommy Gun

This weapon is quite rare to find, due to the fact that it only spawns in supply drops, and even there it is not a 100% guarantee that you might get it. Due to it's extremely high rarity, the weapon was dealing higher damage than the rest. While it's reasonable, we felt the damage output was a bit too high and decided to reduce the amount of damage it does, while also slightly increase it's recoil effects.

Damage Output Changes:

Mythic: 105  -> 89

Recoil Output Changes:

Recoil: 4 -> 5

_________________________________________________________

FULL PATCH NOTES - v1.1.0


New cosmetics added - "Ugly Sweater" set and "Snowed In" set

New Lobby backdrop

Winter decorations and snow effect added

News section added - Featured all relevant in-game events and news

New and improved loading icon and loading screens

Further user interface improvements

Various overall improvements

Weapon balancing, as listed in above (made to slightly lengthen matches a bit longer and provide more of a challenge.)

General map improvements and updates; new trees and buildings added


A few more things we wanted to mention is that we'll be on break until January 2024, so this is the last planned update for 2023. Time for some vacation! Additionally, the game is on sale for 50% off, so grab the game on a sweet discount! (And maybe grab an extra copy for one of your friends)

We also  wanted to take a moment to just say a big; THANK YOU! You support since the release of the game has been incredible. We're committed to improving this game over the course of the next year, and we can't wait for you to see the evolution of the game during each update. We seriously cannot thank you all enough, here's to another year of patches, new content and overall improvements.


We hope you enjoy this update, and we'll see you next year!

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 21, 2023
notes.notes:

We're hope you all are doing well. Our first upcoming major update is in production as we speak, and development is going well. Right now, there isn't exact pin-pointed date for it, but at the latest we expect it to be released is by December of this year. Alongside this, we are also working on a roadmap. Our roadmap is being finalized in terms of plans, and we'll update you all as soon as the roadmap is ready to be shown.

Anyways, today's update consists of both fixes and improvements to the game that should hopefully make it more smoother and better to play. As always, your feedback is important, so we'll be listening with open ears in order to improve everyone's overall experience. 

PATCH NOTES:

Fixed an issue where the music would infinitely loop

UI Improvements & a few overhauls

Improved sound effects

New fonts have been introduced alongside the UI changes

Opening credits improved; you can now skip them if you want to

Loading transitions improved and corrected

Various under-the-hood improvements

We super excited to showcase you all what's coming next to the game, but of course, all will be revealed in due time. We hope you enjoy this update, and we'll be back with some more news soon!

Stay tuned!

Shop: Fixed incorrect price display for certain cosmetics
